h1: Drug & Alcohol Rehabilitation Center in Los Angeles
sub: Outpatient treatment for drug and alcohol use at our Westwood center, while you keep living at home. We're a DHCS certified [addiction treatment center in Los Angeles](/).

hero.caption: The group room in Westwood

sections.q: What is a drug and alcohol rehabilitation center?
sections.a: It's a place where people get structured treatment for drug or alcohol use, mostly therapy in groups and one on one. It's a different thing from physical rehab after an injury or a stroke. Ours is outpatient, so you come in for treatment and go home after.

sections.q: Is Golden State Rehab inpatient or outpatient?
sections.a: Outpatient only. You come to our Westwood center, or join by video, during the day or in the evening. Then you sleep at home every night. There are no beds here and no overnight stays.

sections.q: What services does your rehab center offer?
sections.a: Care starts intensive and loosens as you get steadier. Outpatient drug rehab covers our levels of care, from PHP at about 6 hours a day to IOP with 3-hour sessions. Telehealth rehab brings the IOP schedule to you by video.

items.d: PHP and IOP, from full weekdays down to a few sessions a week
The IOP schedule by video, anywhere in California

sections.q: Is outpatient rehab enough for me?
sections.a: For many people, yes. Outpatient is often the right fit when you're medically stable and have a safe place to sleep. The free assessment is where that gets decided, and if you need more than we offer, we'll tell you.

signs: You're medically stable, or detox is already behind you.

card.title: When outpatient isn't the first step
card.text: If detox or residential care needs to come first, we help you set it up. Your spot here waits for you, and treatment picks up once you're ready.

sections.a: No. As an outpatient center we don't offer detox, and withdrawal from alcohol or benzodiazepines can be dangerous without medical supervision. When your assessment shows you need it, we line up detox with a provider we trust and keep your place here.

steps.d: By referral to a trusted detox provider. We hold your spot.
Structured treatment in Westwood or by video while you live at home.
A full year of weekly alumni groups, plus a monthly check-in.

sections.q: Is your rehab center certified by the state?
sections.a: Yes. We're certified by the California Department of Health Care Services, DHCS #191643AP, and accredited by The Joint Commission since August 12, 2026. Treatment runs under the direction of our medical director, Dr. Eric Chaghouri, MD.

sections.q: Will my insurance pay for rehab?
sections.a: We work with most major PPO plans, and health plans may cover outpatient rehab when it's medically necessary. Before you start, a free benefits check looks at what your plan says. Asking doesn't commit you to anything, and it doesn't notify your employer.
sections.note: Many plans reset the deductible on January 1. If you've already met yours this year, ask us what that means for your care.
